        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug.

        From acad9c4324992b6fcfe4f714a3b6f3a8cf8af929 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bart Van Assche <bvanassche@acm.org>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2021 11:46:06 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: megaraid: Fix a kernel-doc warning

Fix the following kernel-doc warning:

drivers/scsi/megaraid/megaraid_mbox.c:1439: warning: Excess function parameter 'done' description in 'megaraid_queue_command_lck'

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20211129194609.3466071-10-bvanassche@acm.org
Fixes: af049dfd0b10 ("scsi: core: Remove the 'done' argument from SCSI queuecommand_lck functions")
Signed-off-by: Bart Van Assche <bvanassche@acm.org>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>
---
 drivers/scsi/megaraid/megaraid_mbox.c | 1 -
 1 file changed, 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/megaraid/megaraid_mbox.c b/drivers/scsi/megaraid/megaraid_mbox.c
index 14f930d27ca1..2a339d4a7e9d 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/megaraid/megaraid_mbox.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/megaraid/megaraid_mbox.c
@@ -1431,7 +1431,6 @@ mbox_post_cmd(adapter_t *adapter, scb_t *scb)
 /**
  * megaraid_queue_command_lck - generic queue entry point for all LLDs
  * @scp		: pointer to the scsi command to be executed
- * @done	: callback routine to be called after the cmd has be completed
  *
  * Queue entry point for mailbox based controllers.
  */
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a mismatch between the function documentation and the actual function parameters in the `megaraid_queue_command_lck` function. Specifically, the documentation incorrectly included a description for a parameter named 'done', which was removed in a previous commit that eliminated the 'done' argument from SCSI queue command functions. This discrepancy led to a kernel-doc warning indicating that there was an excess function parameter description in the documentation.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was a mismatch between the function documentation and the actual function parameters in the `megaraid_queue_command_lck` function. Specifically, the documentation incorrectly included a description for a parameter named 'done', which was removed in a previous commit that eliminated the 'done' argument from SCSI queue command functions. This discrepancy led to a kernel-doc warning indicating that there was an excess function parameter description in the documentation.
